From: Karyna Shuliak
To: Romy Yamada
Subject: Re: Thank you so much! (and some admin matters....)
Date: Thu, 02 Mar 2017 11:43:04 +0000

Hi Romy!
How are you? I hope your week is going well. Can you believe it is spring already? We had such a warm day
today, I was walking outside in a t-shirt. Is it getting warmer in Tokyo?
Romy, I would be more then happy to provide a feedback about participated experiences in japan. Are there
certain things that you would like me to talk about?
I LOVE the tea set you gave me, everytime I look at it I am thinking of you and Tokyo. Thank you so much!!
Have a good night!
Karyna

On Feb 28, 2017, at 6:23 AM, Romy Yamada <

> wrote:

Hi Karyna (i3 U —
I hope you had a nice weekend back in NY last week! I saw your FB profile picture with sakura and Tokyo
tower, very lovely! I still cant believe that Tokyo lost Karyna.... please come back soon again and thank you so
much for all the precious time and memories. I hope my curation was based on your objective, please let me
know any time if you have any questions about our experiences and tour!
Just before I forget, I put in PDF the receipts records for the payment I have done on behalf. If you need the
copy of the actual receipts, please let me know. I will be processing the payment later today.
When you have time... it would be much appreciated if you can provide us with feedback. Please let me know
how you felt about our service, tour, etc., regarding both the positive and areas for improvement. (With your
permission, we would like topublish along with your name on our website - we are currently working on the
page. We will send you in advance which picture we would like to use with your permission)

1) Name (First name/last name): Karyna Shuliak - the guest from New York
2) Comments about us/our experience and tour:

*Participated experience: tea ceremony, ikebana (flower arrangement), zen meditation, wagashi (Japanese
sweets) making, and shodo (calligraphy)
*Participated tour: Inspirational tour for Japanese hospitality, philosophy, presentation, and attention to details
aesthetics

EFTA00565581

 I hope the tea set will always make you remember the days you spend in Tokyo and if you ever miss Japan,
please take a look below for reading pleasure. We share some interesting stories and this will make you not
miss Japan although you are in NY!

- Instagram https://www.instagram.com/toki.tokyo/?h1=en
- Japanese culture stories: http://www.toki.tokyo/librand
- Artisan stories: http://www.toki.tokyo/artisan-stories/

Should you have any questions or request, please do let me know. Yuko or myself will share with you some
ideas about your table cloth (or wagashi, hehehe) when we see any materials which might be an interest for
you. We keep in touch. Until then, please take care and enjoy NY life :)

Regards,
Romy (I:l

—)

Wows?*
Romy Yamada
TOKI I Experience Curator
Mobile
Web: toki.tokyo I Instagam: toki.tokys
